name: Avatar
blurb: A person, as initials or a picture, alone or stacked into a group.
mechanism: A sized box with `overflow: hidden` and a radius. Initials are the fallback layer underneath the image, so a picture that fails to load reveals them rather than a broken icon. The stack is negative margin plus a ring in the page colour.
caveats: Initials are decoration, not identity — the name has to be in the DOM or in alt text, or the avatar announces as nothing.
A status dot is colour alone. Pair it with a label, or with a title, wherever the state actually matters.
Stacked avatars overlap in DOM order; the first is on top, so put the most relevant person first.
